signature.name: VTask.equivIocMod
signature.type: {α : Type u_1} -> [AddCommGroup α] -> [LinearOrder α] -> [IsOrderedAddMonoid α] -> [hα : Archimedean α] -> {p : α} -> (hp : 0 < p) -> (a : α) -> α ⧸ AddSubgroup.zmultiples p ≃ ↑(Set.Ioc a (a + p))

conventions.statement: The forward map sends the coset of b to the unique representative of b in (a, a+p], computed by toIocMod hp a b.
conventions.note: This is the defining computational content of the equivalence.

conventions.statement: The inverse map sends a subtype element ⟨x, hx⟩ with x ∈ (a, a+p] to the coset [x] in the quotient.
conventions.note: No choice is needed here; inclusion into the quotient is canonical.

conventions.statement: The element a itself does not appear as a representative; the coset of a maps to a+p, the right (closed) endpoint.
conventions.note: This is forced by the Ioc (open on left, closed on right) convention.

facts.statement: ∀ {α : Type*} [AddCommGroup α] [LinearOrder α] [IsOrderedAddMonoid α] [Archimedean α] {p : α} (hp : 0 < p) (a : α), Function.Bijective (VTask.equivIocMod hp a)

facts.statement: ∀ {α : Type*} [AddCommGroup α] [LinearOrder α] [IsOrderedAddMonoid α] [Archimedean α] {p : α} (hp : 0 < p) (a : α) (q : α ⧸ AddSubgroup.zmultiples p), (VTask.equivIocMod hp a).symm (VTask.equivIocMod hp a q) = q

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; certified by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ {α : Type*} [AddCommGroup α] [LinearOrder α] [IsOrderedAddMonoid α] [Archimedean α] {p : α} (hp : 0 < p) (a : α) (x : ↑(Set.Ioc a (a + p))), VTask.equivIocMod hp a ((VTask.equivIocMod hp a).symm x) = x

facts.statement: ∀ {α : Type*} [AddCommGroup α] [LinearOrder α] [IsOrderedAddMonoid α] [Archimedean α] {p : α} (hp : 0 < p) (a : α) (q : α ⧸ AddSubgroup.zmultiples p), a < (VTask.equivIocMod hp a q : α) ∧ (VTask.equivIocMod hp a q : α) ≤ a + p
